notes: The asking device's one-time public key, once the waiting side answered, and that answer as it saw it, which its code is made from; only from the device that asks. 400 bad_request when the key isn't the one the commitment was made for; 409 not_answered before an answer, when the answer changed meanwhile (the waiting side answered again: reveal for the new one), or when it was revealed already; 404 not_found for another device.
